plot: At sunset in Grandma's living room a wrapped gift hops and squeaks by itself; Dog's sneeze, Bird's love of the lamp and Max's jump all scare it away, until Grandma says to sit and speak kindly, and out comes Mouse, who got stuck inside while hiding a little cake for Grandma.

script.title: Who Is Hiding in the Hopping Gift Box?

beats.say: Did you see that? The present just jumped by itself!
It is late afternoon in Grandma's cozy living room. The sun is going down.
A jumping box? Maybe it is full of bouncy balls!
Who put it here? It has a big yellow bow.
Max puts his ear next to the box. Scratch, scratch. Squeak!
It squeaked! Dog, this box can talk!
Hello, box! Do you like belly rubs?
I have a plan. We wait very quietly, and then we peek!
Shh. I am so quiet. Ah... ah... achoo!
The box hops away behind the sofa.
Dog! You scared it away!
My nose did it, not me. My nose is very naughty.
Hello, hello! What are we looking at? Is it a snack?
Bird, a present is hopping around the house all by itself.
Leave it to me! I will fly up and look down inside.
Bird flies up high, and sees the lamp.
Wow, look at this lamp! It is so warm and pretty.
Bird! The box, not the lamp!
But the box has hopped away again. Now it is by the rug.
This is the trickiest present ever. I have one more idea.
I will jump on it, gently, like a feather. Ready, set...
Boing! The box hops away, and Max lands right on Dog.
Oof! Hello, Max. You are a very fluffy pillow.
My, my. Why is everyone rolling around on my rug?
Grandma! There is a present that hops and squeaks!
Hops and squeaks? Hmm. Let us not chase it, dears.
When something is shy, you sit down and speak kindly.
Sit down and speak kindly. Okay, I can do that.
Everyone sits on the rug. Nobody runs. Nobody jumps.
Hello, little box. We are your friends. You can come out.
The box wiggles. The bow wiggles. The lid lifts up slowly.
Surprise! Oh, hello, everybody. You found me.
Mouse! It was you all the time?
I was making a gift for Grandma, and the lid closed on me.
Every time I tried to push out, the box hopped instead!
So the box was not full of bouncy balls? Oh well.
It was full of Mouse! That is even better.
A gift for me? What is it, little one?
It is a cake I made, with one tiny candle.
Mouse gives the little cake to Grandma.
Thank you, Mouse. This is the sweetest surprise I ever had.
And we learned something. Chasing makes shy things run.
That is right, Max. Kind words open more boxes than jumping.
The sun goes down, and everyone shares a tiny bite of cake.
Tomorrow I want to find out where the moon goes in the morning!
